name: Jewels of Rome: Match-3 Game and City Builder
description:
About This Game

Jewels of Rome is a match-3 game with:
• 7,500+ levels
• 6,000+ quests
• 1,000+ collections
You're the newly appointed governor of a forgotten Roman province, devastated by raids and plunder. Once a lively settlement, now it lies in ruins. Your mission is clear—restore the city by solving match-3 puzzles.

Each building you restore brings new opportunities: new characters, new tasks, and new challenges. You'll also take part in time-limited events, unlock seasonal content, and collaborate with friends in team-based competitions. Whether you build alone or as part of a team, the future of the province depends on your strategy and your pace.

Features:
• Match-3 puzzles: Solve hundreds of colorful levels, designed for large screens and easy navigation.
• Story quests: Follow a rich narrative through quests given by unique characters.
• City building: Restore and grow a Roman settlement into a thriving city.
• Social gameplay: Play with friends, join teams, and share rewards.
• Progression freedom: Choose what to build first and shape your own path.
• Resource management: Collect materials, upgrade buildings, and unlock new areas.
• Events and mini-games: Join limited-time challenges and enjoy diverse game modes.

While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.

You can play this game even if you’re offline!

Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Ukrainian.

short_desc: A story-driven match-3 game set in the Roman Empire. Rebuild a fallen settlement and turn it into a large, thriving city. Choose what to build first, complete character quests to explore the story, and solve challenging puzzles. Join limited-time events, play mini-games, and team up with friends.
